content:
alex_r: FYI I'm seeing a p99 latency bump on Llama-3-13B after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Profiling shows more GEMM fallback and extra memcpy. Attaching quick profiler dump.

jaya: ugh, when did we change selector? was it the auto-select for head_dim!=kv_dim?

alex_r: yeah, deploy at 11:22 - we changed kernel routing to prefer fused_kv when head_dim==64; but the runtime now picks generic for head_dim==128 for 13B due to rope_theta handling.

sam_m: can you paste the profiler snippet?

alex_r:
```
KernelTimeline:
  conv_gemm_128x64: 2.4ms (45%)
  generic_gemm: 3.9ms (35%)
  kv_pack: 0.6ms
PrefixCache hits: 12%
```

jaya: prefix cache 12% is low for our chat template. Are we invalidating KV too often? Any change in chat templates / role tokens?

toni: i've seen similar on Mixtral runs — rope scaling mismatch caused an extra rotary fallback path (expensive). rope_theta default mismatch could trigger workaround code.

alex_r: quick note: model metadata for some Llama-3 variants set rope_theta=8192, runtime default assumed 10000. That mismatch forces per-head remapping and prevents fused rotary kernels from being used.

infra-bot: deploy 1753508600 completed: kernel-selector v2 rolled to canary (5%) :white_check_mark: 

sam_m: hypothesis: kernel selector rejects fused_kv when rope_theta != runtime_expected. If true, relaxing that predicate to allow fused path when only theta differs slightly could fix perf without correctness loss.

jaya: also double-check head_dim vs kv_dim: Llama-2 often used head_dim=64, Llama-3 uses 128 in some variants. Many of our optimized kernels only accept <=64, so they fall back.

alex_r: action plan: 1) run perf test forcing fused_kv enabled for the 13B canary 2) bump prefix cache TTL for chat template to reduce KV churn 3) add telemetry event for rope_theta mismatch. I'll open a PR for a relaxed kernel predicate.

toni: +1. Also add a microbench comparing RMSNorm vs SiLU fused paths — subtle memory layout differences change kernel selection.

sam_m: reminder: test with both dedicated and hosted batchers. Our batching heuristics clamp batch size by median seq len; the new chat template increased short-system tokens which changed distribution. Continuous batching thresholds may need retuning.

jaya: if you push a canary with forced fused_kv, I can run load on the dedicated pool and gather full traces.

alex_r: thanks — will push canary + telemetry by EOD and post perf diffs here.

sam_m: also capture KV cache hit breakdown by route and by role (system/user) — that will show whether template tokenization changed invalidation pattern.

jaya: cheers. small follow-up: add an invariant check in runtime logs when we reject fused kernel: include head_dim/kv_dim/rope_theta so triage is faster.

alex_r: agreed. opening issue and linking PR shortly.

toni: nice. we'll also validate no regression on Qwen/Mistral variants since they have different head/kv dims.

alex_r: posted canary build: image rwd/serve:canary-20260315, forcing fused_kv on for llama-3-13b. Running smoke now.

infra-bot: perf-ci started: job 4928 on canary pool.

sam_m: ping when results are in, i'll run long tail test.
